notes.title: Incoming new stuff! + Give us your feedbacks!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32620101/a7b56613cc01fdc45ee9d0b4210ea5d00e85adc8.gif

Greetings to all! 

We will launch a new project at the end of 2019, it is called: JANGA

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1106700/Janga/

Why am I telling you this here? Because we will try to free ourselves for days regularly during the production of this game, to update our previous games.
 
Indeed, the community often asks us on Discord to fix bugs and make minor modifications on our previous games, but currently we have no time for that. It is therefore impossible for us to satisfy your expectations.
We hope that this will change from September 2019!

That's why I attach here the Grotoro feedback form, to recover any problems you may have, and maybe some new ideas you have to improve the game?

Over here for the Grotoro feedback form! https://forms.gle/hFPnvSMMrSqFDnGX7

Have a gelatinous day! 

See ya on Discord!
http://discord.gg/a3qtypa

Concrete Games Team.

notes.title: GROTORO is out NOW for FREE!
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/sRIXhruvHO9BJe6TQf/giphy.gif

Here it is! GROTORO is available for FREE now on Steam!

Features:
4 players epic battles!
Play with AI if you don't have enough friends
Speed control Blobby Volley style: from 50% to 200%
Fully editable controls
Use the "Yaaa" (dash) to hurt and kill your opponents
Master the "Olé" to dodge opponents attacks...
Bounce on screen borders to hit them with style
Hide behind your fat balls to trick other players
Dash into others Grotoros' dash to perform an epic counter
Bouncy interface
Instant fun: 0 tuto, 0 story, 0 loading
Be the last and greasiest Grotoro!

GRO... TO... RO... GROTORO! ;)

Concretely,
